zh-CN: 扫描和拖入阶段只做低成本相似预检，不读取文件内容或计算 MD5；疑似相似项目会先等待人工确认。
精确重复只接受完整相对路径、文件大小和有效 MD5 全部一致，并按设置保留为可审计的已跳过项或从队列移除。
当前任务的精确核验 MD5 会在确认后继续、库内未压缩项目压缩和后续相似报告中复用。
跨目录旧候选使用单项目读取预算，证据不足时转为人工确认；扫描、定时等待和跳过原因统一写入运行日志。
en-US: Scanning and drag-and-drop use low-cost similarity metadata without reading file contents or calculating MD5; possible matches wait for confirmation.
An exact duplicate requires complete relative paths, file sizes and valid MD5 values, then remains as an auditable skipped item or is removed according to the setting.
Current-task MD5 verification is reused after confirmation, for compressing unarchived catalog items and in later similarity reports.
Cross-directory historical candidates use a one-project read budget and fall back to manual review when evidence is incomplete; scan, schedule and skip reasons are recorded in the run log.
